categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/streams.h` to make `BufferedWriter`'s destructor safe and non-throwing, adding explicit `discard()` and `Assume` checks.
categories.rationale: Fixes a regression in stream primitives where unflushed write failures triggered an immediate `std::terminate` crash instead of handled exceptions. As reviewer ryanofsky notes, giving `BufferedWriter` a safer interface where writers flush or discard explicitly removes dangerous destructor re-throws.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to explicitly flush block and undo data and manage write errors gracefully.
categories.rationale: Improves block storage crash safety by catching disk write failures during block and undo flushes and initiating a clean fatal shutdown. Previously, out-of-space write errors abruptly crashed the node via `std::terminate` without clean shutdown or diagnostics.
